## Change

Describe the problem, the expected outcome, and what changes in this PR. Link the issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results. For changes to data, security, or deployment, include
the applicable compatibility or trust-boundary evidence.

## Risk and recovery

Classify the change as routine, elevated, or a change to the merge rules. Describe how to revert or
recover, and what recovery was tested.

## Review

Record the reviewed commit, independent findings and their disposition. Note changes after review.
Before merging, verify the head, base, CI, feedback, and approvals against the
[review and merge rules](docs/review-and-merge.md).
